[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Nssktkslis''' was a [[Cyberneticist/Legends|cybernetic specialist]] who operated out of the [[Mos Entha/Legends|Mos Entha]] medical center.<ref name="SWG:GU12" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Aboo_Aramflahad.png|180px|thumb|''Star Wars Galaxies'' erroneously identified all cybernetic specialists as Aboo Aramflahad.]]
Nssktkslis was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GU12" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Nssktkslis was one of the three cybernetic specialists, along with [[Aboo Aramflahad]] and [[Mindt F'abul]], added to the game with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Game Update 12|Game Update 12]],<ref name="FF">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68388&month=072009|text=Friday Feature – A review of Cybernetics found in Game Update 12}}</ref> on [[August 10]], [[2009]].<ref name="GU12">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=976424|text=Game Update 12: Engineering Trader}}</ref> In the game, all three cybernetic specialists were erroneously identified as Aboo Aramflahad.<ref name="SWG:GU12" /> However, the Friday Feature titled "Review of Cybernetics" identified the cybernetic specialist working in Mos Entha as Nssktkslis.<ref name="FF" />
